bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to civil law; permitting agents to appear on behalf of corporations and limited liability companies in eviction actions; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 504B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[504B.317] AGENTS; POWER OF AUTHORITY TO FILE EVICTION ACTION.

Notwithstanding any law or rule to the contrary, in an eviction action brought under this chapter, an agent may appear on behalf of a landlord that is a corporation or limited liability company. The agent must attach a copy of a power of authority form to the complaint at the time of filing.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to eviction actions filed on or after that date.
